briefings.title: Commissioning gains, SMR development and fuel-cycle buildout
briefings.overview: The week combined two concrete reactor commissioning milestones with a broader pipeline of SMR development, Polish project supply-chain work, fuel-cycle investments, fleet refurbishment and policy decisions. This source-linked briefing separates operating or construction milestones from proposals, development agreements and regulatory steps.

sections.takeaway: Physical deployment milestones led the week: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 reached criticality and Slovakia's Mochovce 4 connected to the grid. Elsewhere, India's PHWR construction preparations and Polish AP1000 procurement illustrate the work required well before a reactor generates electricity.

items.title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 achieves criticality
items.summary: Bangladesh's first commercial nuclear unit reached first criticality during commissioning.

items.title: Mochovce 4 connected to the grid
items.summary: Slovakia's Mochovce 4 began supplying electricity to the grid, marking a commissioning milestone.

items.title: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
items.summary: India reported progress on Kakrapar units 5 and 6, component manufacturing for fleet construction and a design milestone in its SMR programme.

items.title: Westinghouse places initial orders for Polish plant

items.title: Agreement signed on second Polish nuclear power plant
items.summary: Polish state entities agreed on responsibilities for preparatory work for the country's proposed second nuclear power station.

sections.takeaway: The sector saw progress at different levels of maturity rather than a single wave of firm build decisions. Poland announced a proposed six-unit BWRX-300 venture, China's ACP100 underwent pre-fuel hot testing, and the US provided further research support to a molten-chloride reactor experiment. Materials qualification and maritime applications remain development workstreams.

items.title: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
items.summary: SGE and ZE PAK agreed to create a venture for a potential 1,800 MW project at Pątnów comprising as many as six BWRX-300 reactors.

items.summary: Hot functional testing began at the ACP100/Linglong One small reactor demonstration project in Hainan, a pre-fuel-loading commissioning step.

items.title: US DOE funding to accelerate molten salt reactor development
items.summary: US DOE approved cost-shared funding for the Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment, which is targeting first criticality in 2027.

items.title: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
items.summary: Thorizon and TNO launched corrosion and materials testing to support qualification and licensing of molten-salt reactor components.

items.title: US maritime nuclear firm Bluecore Energy announces uranium purchase
items.summary: Bluecore Energy announced acquisition of low-enriched uranium as it advances its maritime nuclear development plans.

sections.takeaway: Fuel availability remained central to future capacity growth. Urenco's additional enrichment cascade represented installed operating capacity, while Newcleo's MOX development centre and Bluecore's uranium purchase were earlier-stage fuel readiness steps—not new commercial enrichment capacity.

items.title: Milestone for Urenco USA expansion project
items.summary: Urenco USA brought a sixth new enrichment cascade into production, reaching 75% completion of its current capacity addition.

items.title: Newcleo opens MOX fuel development centre
items.summary: Newcleo inaugurated a EUR10 million fuel engineering and testing centre in France to support its mixed-oxide fuel development work.

items.title: US maritime nuclear firm Bluecore Energy announces uranium purchase
items.summary: Bluecore Energy announced acquisition of low-enriched uranium as it advances its maritime nuclear development plans.

sections.takeaway: Work on the current reactor fleet continued alongside new-build activity. Bruce 4 refurbishment, EDF replacement steam-generator delivery and the IAEA's Oskarshamn long-term-operation review highlight the component, safety and oversight investment needed to extend plant service life.

items.title: Milestone for Bruce 4 refurbishment
items.summary: Bruce Power completed installation of 480 calandria tubes for the unit 4 refurbishment, progressing its major component replacement programme.

items.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries delivered three replacement steam generators intended for EDF's Cruas unit 2.

sections.takeaway: New nuclear programmes and asset clean-up moved through institutional gates. The Czech Temelín SMR project entered environmental review, Namibia appointed a nuclear coordinator, and Norwegian authorities and contractors advanced plans for spent-fuel management and transfers of decommissioning responsibilities.

sections.takeaway: The legacy Hanhikivi-1 dispute underscores that geopolitical and contractual risks can continue long after a nuclear project is terminated. The legal position should be read from the underlying reporting rather than treated as a final resolution.

items.summary: The fifth new cascade at Urenco USA's uranium enrichment plant in New Mexico has entered production.

items.title: Palisades enters final stage of work before restart
items.summary: Holtec International announced that over the past several weeks, the Palisades restart project reached a "watershed moment" as the last of the major projects were successfully closed out and the site transitioned from large-scale activities to the remaining routine maintenance, testing, inspection, and operational readiness work required before startup.

items.title: Former managers call for restart of German nuclear power plants
items.summary: "Reactivating German nuclear power is a technically feasible and sensible option," a group of former managers of nuclear power plants in Germany and nuclear technology experts have said in a letter to the German government.

items.title: Polish developer applies for CfD for three SMR plants
items.summary: Orlen Synthos Green Energy has applied to Poland's Minister of Energy for a Contract for Difference for the construction of a total of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors at three locations in Poland.

items.title: Blykalla teams up with Hitachi for SMR deployment
items.summary: Sweden's Blykalla and Hitachi Energy - the energy arm of Japan's Hitachi Group - have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore a long-term collaboration on enabling the deployment of next-generation lead-cooled advanced modular reactors.

items.title: International safety review of Finnish SMR design completed
items.summary: Finland's nuclear regulator has published a summary report of a Joint Early Review conducted with regulators from the Czech Republic, Poland, Sweden, and Ukraine to assess the safety of Steady Energy's LDR-50 reactor for district heating.

items.title: Criticality for third US reactor ahead of 4 July deadline
items.summary: Deployable Energy's Unity demonstration reactor has successfully achieved initial criticality at the National Reactor Innovation Center located at Idaho National Laboratory - which means the US has achieved the presidential goal set last year of three microreactors under Department of Energy authorisation to achieve initial criticalities by 4 July 2026.

items.title: Rolls-Royce SMR plans manufacturing development centre in Derby
items.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR has announced plans to open its Pioneer Works facility in Derby, in the East Midlands region of England. It will be its first manufacturing development centre where it will establish the build processes, precision assembly and advanced testing needed to de-risk the delivery of its small modular reactor fleet in the UK, Czech Republic and Sweden.
